clue.text: Gives particulars of key drills fragmenting debris

the Escape key on a computer keyboard

clue.text: Stalwart old guards ruling briefly

clue.text: A number of Catholics in attempt to win chess game with queen

clue.text: Show up, drinking soft drink and alcoholic one

clue.text: Heckle record label releasing disc in rich place

clue.text: Sweet, unknown guy from America's upset

clue.text: Eulogistic report of events around pulpit, oddly

clue.text: Metro jams in a city, holding up group seen at night

indicators.note: the answer is literally in the words that follow

the words hold the answer, containing it across their breaks

clue.text: Where to find posters in English with writing about judicious committee

clue.text: Primates wife expelled from small buildings

clue.text: Parents love president defending Democrat policy — it was divisive in the States

clue.text: Wrote down polite refusal addressed to Edward or Theodore?

clue.text: Where Americans might climb road and can skid off

clue.text: Instigators of youthful offences get incarcerated? One may do a big stretch

definitions.text: One may do a big stretch

clue.text: Cruel legislator with zero wit moving to the left

clue.text: Manager of Hearts, say, admitting this person with sign of hesitation

clue.text: My work environment

clue.text: Savaging idiot repeatedly in letter, I state

clue.text: Determined chap's going to gamble, clutching note

clue.text: Weapon of Persian male, maybe a belligerent sort

clue.text: Tired journalist reported why penury is limiting

clue.text: Trick for one party Democrat backs

clue.text: Female has no doubt over diamonds with cracks in
